title: Agentic OS canonical agent frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a canonical agent .md (framework/roles/ or apex/agents/). The <Agent_Prompt> BODY is not JSON and is checked separately by validate.mjs (see spec.md).

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must equal the filename stem and the emitted .toml name key.

description.description: Load signal: what the agent does + when to use it. One of only two fields projected to Codex.

model.description: Claude model id (e.g. claude-opus-4-6). Claude-only; not emitted to Codex. Optional so a role may inherit the default.

memory.description: Memory scope the agent persists to. Real roster uses only these two.

disallowedTools.description: Comma-separated deny-list — the read-only-lane mechanism (e.g. 'Write, Edit'). Claude-only.

runtime_contract.description: Optional portable runtime I/O contract. The primitive validator checks structure only; enforcement belongs to the runtime instance.

tool_param_schemas.description: Map of tool name to JSON-Schema object or schema pointer.

retry_limit.description: Bounded retry count; runtime enforcement is instance-owned.

handoff_targets.description: Declared agent/role targets this agent may hand off to.
